name: search-for-springfield-population-and-enter-into-excel
title: Search for Springfield Population and Enter into Excel
description: Search for Springfield's population in 2024 on the Searchly website, retrieve the data, and enter it into an Excel spreadsheet. Learned from a recorded demonstration (Searchly - Google Chrome, Excel). 1 step(s) must be confirmed by a human before running.
goal: Search for Springfield's population in 2024 on the Searchly website, retrieve the data, and enter it into an Excel spreadsheet.
prerequisites: The user has access to the Searchly website and the Excel application.
The file '{{file_name}}' is available and loaded in Excel.

population_value.description: The population value for Springfield in 2024 that is to be entered into the Excel cell.

file_name.description: The Excel file containing the data about Springfield.

city_name.description: The city name used in the data entry process.

source_url.description: The URL of the search results page from Searchly.

steps.title: Click on the search bar in Searchly
steps.instruction: Click on the search bar in the Searchly website to focus on it.
steps.expect: The search bar is focused and ready for input.

steps.title: Type 'springfield population 2024' into the search bar
steps.instruction: Type 'springfield population 2024' into the search bar.
steps.expect: The search bar contains the text 'springfield population 2024'.

steps.title: Press Enter to execute the search
steps.instruction: Press Enter to execute the search query for 'springfield population 2024'.
steps.expect: The search results for 'springfield population 2024' are displayed on the page.

steps.title: Click on the '{{city_name}} - Official City Data' link
steps.instruction: Click on the '{{city_name}} - Official City Data' link in the Searchly search results to open the page.
steps.expect: The page displays the city's data, including population, area, and founding year.

steps.title: Switch to Excel application
steps.instruction: Switch to the Excel application from the current window.
steps.expect: The Excel window opens with the '{{file_name}}' file loaded, and the data from the Searchly page is ready to be entered.

steps.title: Click on the 'Population 2024' cell for {{city_name}} in Excel
steps.instruction: Click on the cell in the 'Population 2024' column for {{city_name}} in the Excel table.
steps.expect: The cell is selected and ready for input.

steps.title: Type '{{population_value}}' into the selected cell
steps.instruction: Type the value '{{population_value}}' into the selected cell in the 'Population 2024' column for {{city_name}}.
steps.expect: The cell contains the value '{{population_value}}' and is ready for further actions.
steps.confirmation_reason: Check: Typed "186,412" but "168,412" was seen at 00:00:10 (consistency check).

steps.title: Confirm the value '{{population_value}}' is entered in the cell
steps.instruction: The user has entered the value {{population_value}} into the 'Population 2024' cell for {{city_name}} in the Excel table.
steps.expect: The value {{population_value}} is now displayed in the 'Population 2024' cell for {{city_name}}.

open_questions: The user's action of switching to Excel is confirmed, but is there any indication of a potential error in the switch? The user may have intended to switch to a different application or file.
